text:
rigel: Heads-up — PR #15678 (feature/dedicated-routing) is ready for merge but CI is stuck on macos job (queued ~18m). Need 2 approvals and hoping to land in the 17:30–18:30 rebase window. Can someone grab a quick review? cc @maya @jen

maya: on it, checking now. do we want a canary here? we have the infra maintenance freeze at 18:00 to consider.

rigel: yes canary + rollback. changes touch routing + kv cache keys. plan: canary 10% for 10m, monitor latency/errors, fallback to v1.18 if regressions. rollout snippet we used last time:
```
canary: 10%
monitor: 10m
fallback: v1.18
```

jen: note — deploy freeze starts 18:00 UTC for infra patch. if we don't land + finish canary before freeze, we should abort and wait for tomorrow APAC slot. aiming to merge by 17:45 so canary finishes pre-freeze.

alex: will review now. quick question: did you bump the kv cache TTL in config? that needs release notes.

rigel: pushed a small docs+whitespace change to trigger CI rerun. TTL change is in the PR — added to release notes draft.

liam: CI-SRE here — macos runners had a backlog, I restarted the stuck job and scaled the pool. if you need a fresh run do `gh pr retest` or push a noop commit. linking the job: https://ci.internal/builds/4567

ci-bot: Build #4567 queued -> running on macos-12 at 2798765448

rigel: ran a noop rebase, thanks @liam.

ci-bot: Build #4567 passed checks at 2798765456

alex: LGTM aside from one tiny docstring nit — leaving an inline comment.

maya: approving now. :thumbsup:

jen: setting merge slot for 17:45 UTC and will coordinate with oncall. please don't land before I confirm final go.

rigel: understood. will wait for second approval + green CI. starting the canary plan ready.

merge-bot: PR #15678 mergeable (2 approvals, CI green)

rigel: merging now. starting canary rollout after merge.

merge-bot: PR #15678 merged to main at 2798765462 by merge-bot

rigel: canary started at 17:47 UTC (10% traffic). monitoring latency/errors dashboard and logs.

sam: oncall — I see a small latency spike (~6%) on /models/production at +3m into canary, investigating traces.

jen: if the spike persists beyond 5m, initiate rollback.

sam: spike held ~7m, starting rollback to v1.18 as planned.

merge-bot: Canary rollback completed at 2798765464

rigel: rollback done, reopening PR to debug root cause. thanks for the quick eyes and rollback. we'll rework kv cache change and retest in next window.

maya: great triage — we avoided freeze impact. noted follow-up: add canary telemetry alert thresholds to PR template.

rigel: adding checklist item. thanks everyone. the final plan: re-opened branch, will iterate and rerun full matrix before next slot.
